newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Goodale adds C$15 mln fund for ag biotech.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Goodale adds C$15 mln fund for ag biotech.

text.p: Agricultural research in Canada will be aided by another C$15.125 million which was added to an agricultural biotechnology research fund on Wednesday, Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale said.

The Agri-Food Innovation Fund, a joint program between Agriculture Canada and Saskatchewan Agriculture, gave more than C$42 million to Saskatchewan agri-food researchers since it was established last year, a joint statment said.

The additional funding will provide C$9.3 million for research and development, C$5.3 million for infrastructure and C$525,290 for human resource development, Goodale and Saskatchewan Agriculture Minister Eric Upshall said in the release.
The fund was forecast to invest up to C$91 million in Saskatchewan's agriculture industry by March 31, 2000.
Twenty-four projects are currently being funded.
